primary_dataset.name: MEGA-CDP
primary_dataset.test_policy: official test locked until all model and analysis choices are frozen

external_dataset.name: MedGUIDE-MCQA-8K
external_dataset.test_policy: source-tree heldout from original train split; not an official test split

grouping_unit: source guideline tree/family, never individual case

module_definition.module_1: learn applicability direction/subspace from verified minimal pairs
module_definition.module_2: predict applicability without exposing target actions
module_definition.module_3: apply signed key edits using module-2 predicted routing

primary_comparison: end-to-end module-2-predicted routing plus module-3 ASTER versus no-edit baseline
exclusion_policy: exclude only documented source corruption, invalid/missing gold path, or a pre-registered structural impossibility
never exclude by model correctness, model knowledge, refusal, parse failure, applicability prediction, or intervention outcome
all technical failures remain in the intent-to-evaluate denominator and are separately counted
